business.body: CMO retainer: 65% of new clients; Presentation services: now 10% of revenue (boosted by ISO certification); AI marketing: new vertical with internal tools (Kathai, Etech, Ray); Event management: emerging in India via B2B knowledge events; Branding: growing in Indian manufacturing/GCCs
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin 33% in H1; pressure from senior leadership hires and US client negotiation intensity; target minimum 25% sustainable margin; AI tools reducing content hiring needs, improving unit economics
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: revenue growth: target doubling H1 revenue in H2; margin: sustain >25%; order inflow: aggressive pursuit of US enterprise clients and Indian GCCs; capex/commissioning: no capex planned, but investment in AI tools and leadership hires ongoing
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: ₹7.2Cr from 16 new clients (70% CMO retainers, 30% branding projects); realization ongoing, no backlog disclosed beyond H1
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: US enterprise expansion (Cisco, NVIDIA, PE portfolio companies); Indian market entry (GCCs, manufacturing, employer branding); inorganic acquisition of marketing automation SaaS startup (due diligence underway)
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: Revenue grew 58% YoY driven by 16 new clients and US market expansion, with EBITDA margin at 33% despite leadership hires; the company is building systems, pursuing AI integration, and targeting inorganic growth to scale toward ₹100Cr+ revenue, making its transition from founder-led to institutional-ready the key inflection point.
